lines.1: 「Please wake up! It's morning! If you don't get up...」
lines.2: 「...It's still pitch-black outside, I'll have you know.」
lines.3: The time was--three in the morning?!
lines.4: That Crab... She set my alarm for three in the morning. So this was revenge for the bedsheet steam-wrap.
lines.5: I switched off the alarm clock with the idol's prerecorded voice.
lines.6: She really knew how to get on people's nerves.
